entities.name: Alexandre Rodrigues Ferreira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandre Rodrigues Ferreira was a Portuguese naturalist born in Brazil. He undertook an extensive journey which crossed the interior of the Amazon Basin to Mato Grosso, between 1783 and 1792. During this journey, he described the agriculture, flora, fauna, and native inhabitants.
